reviews: [★5] Gorgeous 144Hz curved pOLED display - Colors are rich and vibrant, HDR content looks magnificent, and the curve gives a bezel-less immersive feel.
[★5] Premium vegan leather finish - The back panel feels extremely luxurious in hand and provides fantastic grip without a case.
[★5] Flagship-grade Sony LYT-700C camera - 50MP OIS camera takes outstanding low-light shots and natural portrait depth.
[★5] IP68 underwater rating - Submerged in pool water for 15 minutes, absolutely zero issues. Unmatched water protection at this price.
[★5] Clean Hello UI software - Near stock Android experience with zero bloatware ads, smooth animations, and useful Moto gestures.
[★4] Super fast 68W TurboPower charging - Goes from 10% to 80% in just under 30 minutes with the bundled charger.
[★4] Stereo speakers with Dolby Atmos - Incredibly loud, rich stereo separation with deep mids for movies.
[★4] Smooth Snapdragon 7s Gen 2 - Handles heavy multitasking, photo editing, and casual gaming smoothly.
[★4] 32MP selfie camera with 4K video - High resolution front camera with excellent dynamic range for video calling.
[★5] Super light and slim - Only 175 grams with curved edges that rest naturally in palm.
[★4] Fast 5G network speeds - 15 5G bands support with blazing fast speeds on Jio True 5G.
[★4] Smart Connect integration - Effortlessly mirrors screen to Windows PC with shared clipboard.
[★3] Curved screen accidental touches - Occasionally registers palm touch when reaching across screen without a case.
[★3] Moderate battery under 144Hz - 5000 mAh battery lasts about a full day, but heavy gaming drains it quicker.
[★3] Plastic frame between glass and back - Polycarbonate mid-frame rather than aluminum alloy.
[★5] Brilliant design aesthetic - Marshmallow Blue color turns heads everywhere. Looks much more expensive than it is.
[★4] Reliable in-display fingerprint reader - Fast optical sensor positioned comfortably near bottom center.
[★4] Generous storage and RAM - 8GB LPDDR4X RAM keeps multiple apps suspended in memory seamlessly.
[★5] Complete all-rounder - Truly the best mid-range phone of the year, combining camera, display, and water resistance.
[★4] Clear microphone pickup - Crystal clear calls even in windy outdoor conditions.
[★4] 1600 nits peak brightness - Easily visible under direct blazing Indian afternoon sunlight.
[★5] Great haptic feedback - Tight tactile clicks while typing on Gboard.
[★4] Dependable software update promise - Promised 3 OS upgrades and 4 years of security patches.
[★4] Wide-angle and macro in one - 13MP ultra-wide camera has autofocus for macro close-ups.
[★5] Fantastic unboxing experience - Fragrant eco-friendly box with charger and cable included in box.
[★3] Slight warmth during 4K 60fps recording - Device gets warm around camera ring after 15 mins of continuous 4K video.
[★4] Excellent Bluetooth audio codecs - Supports LDAC, aptX Adaptive for high-resolution wireless headphones.
[★5] Absolutely in love with this phone - Switched from an older iPhone and couldn't be happier with the screen and camera.
[★4] Durable Gorilla Glass 5 - Scratch resistant against keys and coins in pocket.
[★5] Top tier recommendation - If you have a 25k budget, buy this without second thought.
